test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by four conclusions numbered I, Il, Ill and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some advocates are doctors.

Some doctors are players.

All players are engineers.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some players are doctors.

Il. Some engineers are advocates.

Ill. All advocates are engineers.

IV. Some engineers are doctors.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Both conclusions I and IV follow
Both conclusions I and III follow
Both conclusions II and IV follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81762fb525c71a3245c0ecac9bda04236ff02d4f1cb428bfc28466267e6bd97a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some players are doctors → True (As some doctors are players, so some players are doctors is True)

Il. Some engineers are advocates → False (No direct relation is given hence, False)

Ill. All advocates are engineers → False (No direct relation is given hence, False)

IV. Some engineers are doctors→ True (As all players are engineers and some doctors are players, So some engineers are doctors is True)

Thus, **Both conclusions I and IV follow**.
